sectors.title: The 9 Feng Shui Sectors
sectors.subtitle: Each sector corresponds to a direction, an element and an aspect of your life. The {year} analysis includes flying stars for precise recommendations.
sectors.origins: Feng Shui is an ancient Chinese art of harmonizing energy (Chi) in living spaces. Based on the observation of natural cycles, it uses the 5 elements ~ Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water ~ and 8 cardinal directions to harmonize energy flow in your home. The compass school (Xuan Kong) and flying star system (Fei Xing) determine favorable and unfavorable zones in each space, year after year.
